caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a western saddle with ornate silver embellishments. The saddle itself is rendered in shades of dark brown and black, with lighter brown accents resembling leather stitching around the edges. Draped over one side of the saddle are three large, silver elements with intricate linework and engraved patterns. The uppermost silver piece, located at the top of the composition, is circular and decorated with a geometric starburst design. Below it is a highly detailed engraving of a large bird, possibly an eagle, with outstretched wings and finely drawn feathers. The bird is followed by a heart-shaped silver plate at the bottom, which is adorned with symmetrical, flowing scrollwork. The composition isolates the saddle and silver pieces against a plain, light background, and the artist’s name, "Harry Mann Waddell," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Stirrup
